messages:
Rae CSM: Quick dump from this week's renewal & onboarding calls. Consolidated signals that should go to product triage. Short version: customers keep surfacing three clusters — export schema variability (line_items vs flattened), per-route cost visibility confusion (billing appears aggregated), and embedding similarity regressions when we inject account-specific prefixes. Also a small enablement ask: sample webhook retry patterns. Full notes below.

Diego CS Ops: can we get counts by segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise)? Prioritization depends on churn risk.

Rae CSM: nailed it. Quick counts from notes: 4 enterprise accounts (including BeaconHealth) hit export schema mismatch, 7 mid-market asked about per-route cost breakdowns, 3 flagged embeddings mismatch (all on dedicated pools, model variant emb-large-q8). One enterprise (BeaconHealth) put renewal on hold until export mapping is fixed 1 days to renewal.

Mika (PM): thanks. Product questions: 1) For exports 1 do customers want configurable templates or examples? 2) For per-route cost 1 is it missing in UI or just unclear wording? 3) Embeddings 1 is there a consistent repro we can give Eng?

Rae CSM: BeaconHealth expected a nested line_items column; our CSV flattens to multiple rows which breaks their ETL join. They shared a sample header: order_id,line_items_json,total_price,customer_facing_tokens. They expect line_items_json to be RFC-8259 JSON string per row.

Diego CS Ops: attached sanitized sample (in-thread) and created a short sheet with all account notes: https://drive.redwood.example/sheets/onboard-export-issues (internal).

Omar (Eng): for embeddings regression, can you paste two example pairs (orig vs prefixed) with observed similarity? I need to run them through our evaluation harness (we'll check both q8 and fp16 variants). Also which runtime were they on 1 dedicated or hosted?

Rae CSM: pasted inline minimal examples: Pair1 orig_vs_prefix sim=0.72 expected 
 expected>0.9, Pair2 sim=0.61 expected>0.85. All reported on dedicated pools and emb-large-q8.

Mika (PM): initial prioritization proposal: P0 - BeaconHealth export template + one-off migration support (risky renewal); P1 - per-route cost UI copy + small drilldown; P1 - embeddings probe and temporary routing rule if q8 regresses; P2 - public enablement snippet for webhooks. Agree?

Diego CS Ops: agree on order. For BeaconHealth, they requested a one-off export this week. Omar, can Eng run a transform for them or give a safe CLI they can run?

Omar (Eng): we can produce a CSV with JSON-escaped line_items as a one-off; need dataset id and retention consent. For long term, adding export templates is straightforward (API + UI) but needs product design and ~2 sprints. For embeddings 1 I'll reproduce locally and share a short report by EOD tomorrow. If q8 shows consistent downward bias on prefixed contexts, we can add a routing rule to avoid q8 for customers that inject prefixes while we triage.

Rae CSM: BeaconHealth provided dataset id DH-99321 and gave permission for manual export. I'll DM the data access window and confirm.

ops-bot: Created triage ticket: CS-EXPORT-4321. Meeting scheduled: 2025-04-02 10:30 PT. Invite sent.

Mika (PM): action items before triage: 1) Diego 1 consolidate per-segment counts and attach BeaconHealth notes; 2) Omar 1 reproduce embeddings pairs on q8 vs fp16 and share harness command (include env vars); 3) Rae 1 confirm dataset id and request manual export. We'll run impact x effort in meeting and decide if we route BeaconHealth to manual export + temporary billing credit.

Diego CS Ops: I'll also surface whether any other renewals are in next 30 days to compute potential churn exposure.

Rae CSM: thank you 1 goal is ship the BeaconHealth export within 48 hours, deliver embeddings repro by tomorrow EOD, and have product backlog item for export templates scoped in the next planning cycle. :white_check_mark:
